articles.summary: Every call handled by a Giga voice agent can now be screened, as the conversation happens, for signs that the speaker on the other end is not a person but a machine.
articles.title: Real-Time Synthetic Voice Detection Comes to Giga

articles.summary: Giga’s voice AI agents can now schedule and place callbacks on their own. A customer who gets interrupted mid-call picks a time, and the agent calls back then — carrying the conversation’s context and memory forward, so nobody has to repeat themselves.
articles.title: Scheduled callbacks for Giga voice agents
